text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Blue: substation's residual (observed minus forecast, points of effective capacity, arm D). Grey: interconnected Primaries' residual (BG2). Dashed black: the day's sharpest edge, if any. Purple: detector onset. Orange ticks: hand-filtered rows left out of the scoring. Grey rules mark the day's start and end; the x axis shows hours from the day's start.'
text.tspan: Blue: substation's residual (observed minus forecast, points of effective capacity, arm D). Grey:
interconnected Primaries' residual (BG2). Dashed black: the day's sharpest edge, if any. Purple:
detector onset. Orange ticks: hand-filtered rows left out of the scoring. Grey rules mark the day's
start and end; the x axis shows hours from the day's start.
